vo_open.text: This man declared himself Emperor of the United States.

vo.text: Joshua Norton lost his fortune betting on rice. Then he sent a newspaper his proclamation.
vo.cap: He lost his fortune *on rice.* Then: a *proclamation.*

vo.text: Emperor Norton the First ordered Congress dissolved. Congress ignored him.
vo.cap: *Emperor Norton I* ordered Congress *dissolved.* It ignored him.

vo.text: But San Francisco played along. Some shops accepted his own money.
vo.cap: San Francisco *played along.* Some shops took *his money.*

vo.text: He also ordered a bridge across the bay. Today, there is one.
vo.cap: He ordered a *bridge across the bay.* Today, *there is one.*
